Upon his descent, a black-and-white image of a laughing horse with large teeth is keyed over his head. (5) A fifth man in a black short-sleeved shirt with white text on the chest jumps against the white wall background. When he lands, his head is replaced with a face that appears to have a stocking pulled over it, creating a distorted and comical expression. (6) A sixth man wearing a grey-and-white tie-dye shirt jumps. His face is substituted with a high-contrast image of a proboscis monkey with a large, bulbous nose as the camera zooms slightly into the static face overlay. As he lands, the 'crying cat' meme face, characterized by watery eyes and a distressed mouth, is superimposed over his face. (8) An eighth man with vibrant pink hair and a light blue collared shirt jumps against the white wall. His face is replaced by a pale, sagging blobfish image, concluding the series of transformations.
